$notes: Signed KKSOLSC1 Solana instruction schemas, keyed "<programId>:<discriminatorHex>". A schema names no amounts and no tx hash, so ONE signature covers every future call — the device decodes values from the bytes it signs. Generated by keepkey-sdk tests/fixtures/solana-schema.js. Signed with the CI TEST key (slot 3); production entries need the slot-0 key. NOTE: a schema is never applied to a lookup-table-backed instruction, so the host must inline ALT accounts first.
